items.q: Cold heading or machining — which is right for my part?
items.a: Cold heading forms the part from wire at room temperature with almost no scrap, so unit cost drops sharply at volume and the grain flow follows the head shape. Machining suits low volumes or geometry that cannot be formed. We cold-head first and add turning only where the drawing needs it.

items.q: What is the minimum order for a custom part?
items.a: 100,000 pieces per part. Tooling is dedicated to your geometry, so the quantity has to carry it; the first order ships in 35–40 days. Standard DIN / ISO parts start at 50,000 pieces per size.
Sample cost [待确认：样品费，D21]. Samples typically ship within 15 days. Send the annual quantity with your drawing; it determines the tooling route and the sample quotation.
